name: invasion
title: 小绿龙入侵

stockData.AI_hero_id: unit_main typeids (e.g. 400101); used directly as heroes[].typeid

rpc_s_enter_invasion.localAdapter: handleEnterInvasion → buildInvasionEnterDict; home buildings remapped into self.units; garrison heros injected into the same map with did remapped to bunker SID
rpc_s_enter_invasion.notes: Stock GameControllerInvasion.initLevelFromData only creates self.units (not self.heros). Client may call InvasionController.enable() (consume crystal 1105) before RPC

rpc_s_invasion_wave_end.localAdapter: handleInvasionWaveEnd; first-clear uses input_id_first then input_id; persists localInvasionFirstWaves

garrison.rule: heroes with did/defense_id matching a home bunker SID are copied into self.units; attack-team heros stay out

openGaps: Official server heroes composition / leadership soldiers not restored from capture
Honor medal kill rewards during wave not yet mirrored
